import sys

def count_inversions(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if arr[i] > arr[j]:
                inversions += 1
    return inversions

def find_rotation_with_max_inversions(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    max_inversions = -1
    best_rotation_index = -1
    
    for k in range(n):
        rotated_arr = arr[k:] + arr[:k]
        inversions = count_inversions(rotated_arr)
        
        if inversions > max_inversions or (inversions == max_inversions and k < best_rotation_index):
            max_inversions = inversions
            best_rotation_index = k
    
    return best_rotation_index, max_inversions

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    T = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        arr = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        
        rotation_index, max_inversions = find_rotation_with_max_inversions(arr)
        results.append(f"{rotation_index} {max_inversions}")
    
    print("\n".join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
